thread:
sam: Heads-up — starting schema migration for orders_v2 tonight at 23:00 PT. Plan: add column `order_meta` (jsonb) + streaming backfill. Canary pinned to orders_read_v2:1.2.0. Deploybot will run canary and apply holdpoints if needed.
marta: Backfill estimate ~12M rows. We'll run concurrent workers but rate-limit to avoid hot shards. Target throughput ~6k rps sustained during window.
alex: Add explicit holdpoint if per-shard rowlock_wait > 5s or db.rowlock.rate > 0.5%.
ops-bot: @sam scheduled migration window: 2026-03-22T06:00Z → 2026-03-22T07:00Z. Canary nodes: gd-1, gd-2, gd-3.
sam: Rollout flags: `feature.orders_v2=true` on canary only. Fallback to v1 on failures. Release notes draft uploaded to /docs/releases/orders_v2_migration.md.
deploybot: Canary started on gd-1 at 1776543220. Logs: "apply schema", "backfill 0/12M". Link: https://deploy/logs/1776543211
irene: Quick ask — pin DB migration tool to 0.9.8 (0.9.7 had smoothing bug that can spike locks). Can someone confirm?
sam: Confirmed. Tool pinned to 0.9.8 and documented in the release note. Also enabled `JOURNAL=true` to make backfill resumable.
marta: Observing a rowlock spike on replica for shard-7 — tail 12s on some writes. I'm pausing the backfill workers on canary now, moving to holdpoint for investigation.
sam: Pausing job workers and scaling thread count down. Switching canary traffic to read-only to reduce pressure.
alex: Decision: do not full rollback yet. Pause backfill and replace with streamed async job (lower contention) if possible. If rowlock rate doesn't fall below 0.5% in 10m -> escalate to rollback.
ops-bot: Alert created: `db.rowlock.rate > 0.5%` (shard-7). Pager policy: SRE on-call + DB guild.
sam: Approved pause. @deploybot set holdpoint at 1776543240.
deploybot: Holdpoint acknowledged. Canary backfill paused. To resume: `/deploy resume 1776543211`.
irene: Please prep rollback playbook in parallel. Is the migration reversible? Share checksum of reverse script and affected consumer list.
marta: Reversible script exists but requires consumers pinned for a short window. Consumers to pin: checkout-service, billing-worker, invoicing-lambda. I'll ping owners now.
sam: OK — we'll wait 10m. If no effective mitigation, we run rollback and notify SRE + product.
deploybot: Note: automatic fallback to `orders_read_v1` scheduled at 1776543300 if no manual action taken before then.
alex: Quick docs action: add a brief note in the release that this migration hit shard imbalance causing hot rows and that the holdpoint was used.
marta: tagging owners and posting consumer pins. :eyes:
sam: Thanks — will capture postmortem seeds now and keep thread updated.
